name: German-SLR-Bench
description: German-SLR-Bench benchmarks models on German Sign Language recognition and related tasks, mapping video (manual and non-manual cues) to glosses or textual translations. It measures model ability to recognize sign units and produce accurate textual outputs for downstream evaluation. The dataset supports evaluation of sequence labeling and translation-style metrics for sign language understanding.
evaluation_method: word error rate (WER) for translation tasks and accuracy / exact match for recognition tasks
reputation: A specialized benchmark for German sign language recognition hosted on Hugging Face; of interest to the sign-language and multimodal research community but with limited broad adoption.
